```{r}
physeq_LT <- readRDS("/LT_physeq_scrub_0.98clustered.rds") %>%
  rename_sample_data(mouseID = animalID)

physeq_LT <- subset_samples(physeq_LT, !(mouseID %in% c("EO4.2_MR", "EO4.2_ML", "EO4.6_ML", "EO4.2_MN", "EO4.7_MN", "EO4.11_FR", "EO4.5_FN"))) # filter out mice that died during the experiment

physeq_ST <- readRDS("ST_physeq_scrub_0.98clustered.rds") %>%
  rename_sample_data(mouseID = animal_ID)

physeq_ST <- subset_taxa(physeq_ST, Kingdom != "unassigned" & Family != "Mitochondria") # Eukaryota (Kingdom) and Chloroplast (Class) as well, if present
```

## Short-term
```{r calc-diversity-metrics}
alpha_div_ST <- data.frame(estimate_richness(physeq_ST, measures = c("Shannon", "Observed")), sample_data(physeq_ST)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(treatment)) %>%
  mutate(
    treatment = str_replace(treatment, "Control", "Ctrl"),
    diet = str_replace(diet, "HF", "HFD"),
    diet = str_replace(diet, "CTRL", "CD"),
    weeks_on_diet = age_weeks - 6,
    diet_new = if_else(timepoint %in% c("t0", "t1"), "chow", diet),
    diet_new = factor(diet_new, levels = c("chow", "CD", "HFD")),  
    treatment_diet = paste(treatment, diet, sep = "_"),
    treatment_diet_new = paste(treatment, diet_new, sep = "_")
  )
```


```{r}
#Set pre and post diet intervention
alpha_div_ST <- alpha_div_ST %>%
  mutate(
    Phase = case_when(
      weeks_on_diet %in% c(-2, 0) ~ "Pre",  
      weeks_on_diet %in% c(1)        ~ "Post", 
      TRUE                              ~ NA_character_ 
    )
  )

alpha_div_ST$Phase <- factor(alpha_div_ST$Phase, levels = c("Pre", "Post"))
```

```{r}
#Pre diet switch, Shannon

summ_ci <- function(x, widths = c(0.95)) {
  qi <- tidybayes::median_qi(x, .width = widths)
  tibble(median = qi$.value, CI_low = qi$.lower, CI_high = qi$.upper)
}

# 1. Filter Data
data_pre <- alpha_div_ST %>% 
  filter(Phase == "Pre") %>%
  mutate(
    # Ensure TimePoint is a factor (e.g., "Week -1", "Week 0")
    weeks_on_diet = factor(weeks_on_diet) 
  )



# 2. Run the Model

model_baseline <- brm(
  formula = Shannon ~ sex * treatment * weeks_on_diet + (1 | mouseID),
  data = data_pre,
  family = student(), 
  prior = c(
    prior(normal(0, 1), class = "b"),
    prior(student_t(3, 0, 1), class = "sigma")
  ),
  chains = 4, iter = 4000,
  backend = "cmdstanr"
)

mf <- model.frame(model_baseline)

grid_pre <- tidyr::expand_grid(
  sex = unique(mf$sex),
  treatment = unique(mf$treatment),
  weeks_on_diet = levels(mf$weeks_on_diet)
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    sex = factor(sex, levels = unique(mf$sex)),
    treatment = factor(treatment, levels = unique(mf$treatment)),
    weeks_on_diet = factor(weeks_on_diet, levels = levels(mf$weeks_on_diet))
  )

draws_pre <- grid_pre %>%
  tidybayes::add_epred_draws(
    model_baseline,
    ndraws = 2000,
    re_formula = NA
  )

# 3) Average across baseline weeks within each draw, for each sex+treatment
pre_means <- draws_pre %>%
  group_by(.draw, sex, treatment) %>%
  summarise(Mean_Shannon = mean(.epred), .groups = "drop")

# 4) Manual contrast: Hp - Ctrl within each draw + sex
baseline_diff <- pre_means %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = treatment, values_from = Mean_Shannon) %>%
  mutate(Hp_minus_Ctrl = Hp - Ctrl) %>%
  select(.draw, sex, Hp_minus_Ctrl)

baseline_stats <- baseline_diff %>%
  group_by(sex) %>%
  summarise(
    Effect = median(Hp_minus_Ctrl),
    CI_Lower = quantile(Hp_minus_Ctrl, 0.025),
    CI_Upper = quantile(Hp_minus_Ctrl, 0.975),
    Prob_Decrease = mean(Hp_minus_Ctrl < 0),
    Pd = pmax(mean(Hp_minus_Ctrl < 0), mean(Hp_minus_Ctrl > 0)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 3)))

print(baseline_stats)

pre_plot_df <- baseline_diff %>%
  group_by(sex) %>%
  summarise(
    median  = median(Hp_minus_Ctrl),
    CI_low  = quantile(Hp_minus_Ctrl, 0.025),
    CI_high = quantile(Hp_minus_Ctrl, 0.975),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    phase = "Pre (Chow)",
    biomarker = "Alpha diversity (Shannon)",
    label = "Treatment (Hp − Ctrl), baseline (mean of chow weeks)",
    type = "Simple Effects"
  )
```


```{r}
### Is the change in Shannon diversity after diet change affected by the treament?

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Create delta outcome (Post - mean(Pre)) per mouse
# ------------------------------------------------------------
delta_data <- alpha_div_ST %>%
  filter(Phase %in% c("Pre", "Post")) %>%
  group_by(mouseID) %>%
  filter(any(Phase == "Pre"), any(Phase == "Post")) %>%
  summarise(
    delta_Shannon = mean(Shannon[Phase == "Post"], na.rm = TRUE) -
                    mean(Shannon[Phase == "Pre"], na.rm = TRUE),
    sex       = first(sex),
    treatment = first(treatment),
    diet      = first(diet),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    sex       = factor(sex, levels = c("female", "male")),
    diet      = factor(diet, levels = c("CD", "HFD")),
    treatment = factor(treatment, levels = c("Ctrl", "Hp"))
  )
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Fit model on delta (difference scale)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
model_post_switch <- brm(
  delta_Shannon ~ sex * diet * treatment,
  data = delta_data,
  family = student(),
  prior = c(
    prior(normal(0, 0.5), class = "b"),
    prior(student_t(3, 0, 1), class = "sigma")
  ),
  chains = 4, iter = 4000, warmup = 2000,
  backend = "cmdstanr",
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99),
  seed = 123
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Posterior predictions on a grid
# ------------------------------------------------------------
grid_post <- tidyr::expand_grid(
  sex       = levels(delta_data$sex),
  diet      = levels(delta_data$diet),        # CD, HFD
  treatment = levels(delta_data$treatment)    # Ctrl, Hp
)

preds_post <- model_post_switch %>%
  add_epred_draws(newdata = grid_post, ndraws = 2000, re_formula = NA) %>%
  group_by(.draw, sex, diet, treatment) %>%
  summarise(epred = mean(.epred), .groups = "drop")

# Helper: summarize draw-level effects into median + CI
summ_eff <- function(df, label, type) {
  df %>%
    group_by(sex) %>%
    summarise(
      median  = median(effect),
      CI_low  = quantile(effect, 0.025),
      CI_high = quantile(effect, 0.975),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      phase = "Post (Diet switch)",
      biomarker = "Alpha diversity (Shannon)",
      label = label,
      type  = type
    )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# B) MAIN EFFECTS (marginalized)
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# Treatment main effect: (Hp - Ctrl), averaged across diets
eff_main_treat <- preds_post %>%
  group_by(.draw, sex, treatment) %>%
  summarise(mu = mean(epred), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = treatment, values_from = mu) %>%
  mutate(effect = Hp - Ctrl) %>%
  select(.draw, sex, effect) %>%
  summ_eff(label = "Treatment (Hp − Ctrl)", type = "Main Effects")

# Diet main effect: (HFD - CD), averaged across treatments
eff_main_diet <- preds_post %>%
  group_by(.draw, sex, diet) %>%
  summarise(mu = mean(epred), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = diet, values_from = mu) %>%
  mutate(effect = HFD - CD) %>%
  select(.draw, sex, effect) %>%
  summ_eff(label = "Diet (HFD − CD)", type = "Main Effects")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# C) SIMPLE EFFECTS (within strata)
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# Treatment simple effects within each diet: (Hp - Ctrl) in CD / HFD
eff_simple_treat <- preds_post %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = treatment, values_from = epred) %>%
  mutate(effect = Hp - Ctrl) %>%
  group_by(.draw, sex, diet) %>%
  summarise(effect = mean(effect), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(sex, diet) %>%
  summarise(
    median  = median(effect),
    CI_low  = quantile(effect, 0.025),
    CI_high = quantile(effect, 0.975),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    phase = "Post (Diet switch)",
    biomarker = "Alpha diversity (Shannon)",
    type = "Simple Effects",
    label = paste0("Treatment (Hp − Ctrl) in ", diet)
  )

# Diet simple effects within each treatment: (HFD - CD) in Ctrl / Hp
eff_simple_diet <- preds_post %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = diet, values_from = epred) %>%
  mutate(effect = HFD - CD) %>%
  group_by(.draw, sex, treatment) %>%
  summarise(effect = mean(effect), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(sex, treatment) %>%
  summarise(
    median  = median(effect),
    CI_low  = quantile(effect, 0.025),
    CI_high = quantile(effect, 0.975),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    phase = "Post (Diet switch)",
    biomarker = "Alpha diversity (Shannon)",
    type = "Simple Effects",
    label = paste0("Diet (HFD − CD) in ", treatment)
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# D) INTERACTION: [ (Hp-Ctrl) in HFD ] - [ (Hp-Ctrl) in CD ]
# ------------------------------------------------------------
eff_interaction <- preds_post %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = treatment, values_from = epred) %>%
  mutate(Hp_minus_Ctrl = Hp - Ctrl) %>%
  select(.draw, sex, diet, Hp_minus_Ctrl) %>%
  group_by(.draw, sex, diet) %>%
  summarise(Hp_minus_Ctrl = mean(Hp_minus_Ctrl), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = diet, values_from = Hp_minus_Ctrl) %>%
  mutate(effect = HFD - CD) %>%
  select(.draw, sex, effect) %>%
  summ_eff(label = "Interaction: (Hp−Ctrl) HFD − CD", type = "Interaction")

# Baseline row (already summarized)
pre_plot_df <- pre_plot_df %>%
  mutate(
    phase = "Pre (Chow)",
    biomarker = "Alpha diversity (Shannon)",
    type = "Simple Effects",
    label = "Treatment (pre diet switch)"
  )

# Standard short labels for Shannon
recode_labels_shannon <- function(x) {
  case_when(
    str_detect(x, "pre diet switch") ~ "Treatment (pre diet switch)",

    x == "Diet (HFD − CD)" ~ "Diet",
    x == "Treatment (Hp − Ctrl)" ~ "Treatment",

    str_detect(x, "^Interaction") ~ "Interaction",

    str_detect(x, "^Diet \\(HFD − CD\\) in Ctrl") ~ "Diet in Ctrl",
    str_detect(x, "^Diet \\(HFD − CD\\) in Hp")   ~ "Diet in Hp",
    str_detect(x, "^Treatment \\(Hp − Ctrl\\) in CD")  ~ "Treatment in CD",
    str_detect(x, "^Treatment \\(Hp − Ctrl\\) in HFD") ~ "Treatment in HFD",

    TRUE ~ x
  )
}

label_levels_std <- c(
  "Diet in Ctrl",
  "Diet in Hp",
  "Treatment in CD",
  "Treatment in HFD",
  "Interaction",
  "Diet",
  "Treatment",
  "Treatment (pre diet switch)"
)

plot_df_div <- bind_rows(
  pre_plot_df,
  eff_main_diet,
  eff_main_treat,
  eff_interaction,
  eff_simple_diet,
  eff_simple_treat
) %>%
  mutate(
    label = recode_labels_shannon(as.character(label)),
    label = factor(label, levels = label_levels_std),
    type  = factor(type, levels = c("Main Effects", "Interaction", "Simple Effects")),
    sex   = factor(sex, levels = c("female", "male"))
  )

# ---- Forest plot (difference scale) ----
ST_Shannon_fecal_pre_post_forest <- ggplot(plot_df_div,
  aes(y = label, x = median, color = sex)
) +
  geom_pointrange(
    aes(xmin = CI_low, xmax = CI_high, shape = type),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.6),
    size = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +   
  scale_color_manual(values = c("female" = "#b19cd9", "male" = "#6a0dad")) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(
    "Main Effects"   = 16,
    "Interaction"    = 18,
    "Simple Effects" = 15
  )) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y        = element_text(color = "black"),
    legend.position    = "bottom",
    legend.box         = "vertical"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Effect difference (Hp − Ctrl)",
    y = "",
    color = "Sex",
    shape = "Effect type"
  )

ST_Shannon_fecal_pre_post_forest


```

```{r}
#fecal richness pre-post switch

data_pre <- alpha_div_ST %>%
  filter(Phase == "Pre") %>%
  mutate(
    weeks_on_diet = factor(weeks_on_diet),
    sex = factor(sex, levels = c("female", "male")),
    treatment = factor(treatment, levels = c("Ctrl", "Hp"))
  )

data_post <- alpha_div_ST %>%
  filter(Phase == "Post") %>%
  mutate(
    sex = factor(sex, levels = c("female", "male")),
    treatment = factor(treatment, levels = c("Ctrl", "Hp")),
    diet = factor(diet, levels = c("CD", "HFD"))
  )

# -----------------------------
# 1) BASELINE NB mixed model (Pre only)
# -----------------------------
model_baseline_ob_nb <- brm(
  Observed ~ sex * treatment * weeks_on_diet + (1 | mouseID),
  data = data_pre,
  family = negbinomial(link = "log"),
  prior = c(
    prior(normal(0, 1), class = "b"),        # effects on log mean
    prior(exponential(1), class = "shape"),  # overdispersion
    prior(exponential(1), class = "sd")      # RE SD
  ),
  chains = 4, iter = 4000, warmup = 2000,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99),
  backend = "cmdstanr",
  seed = 123
)


# ============================================================
# BASELINE (Pre): Hp/Ctrl ratio averaged across chow weeks
# ============================================================
grid_pre_ob <- tidyr::expand_grid(
  sex = levels(data_pre$sex),
  treatment = levels(data_pre$treatment),
  weeks_on_diet = levels(data_pre$weeks_on_diet)
)

draws_pre_ob <- model_baseline_ob_nb %>%
  add_epred_draws(newdata = grid_pre_ob, ndraws = 2000, re_formula = NA)

pre_means_ob <- draws_pre_ob %>%
  group_by(.draw, sex, treatment) %>%
  summarise(mu = mean(.epred), .groups = "drop")

baseline_ratio_ob <- pre_means_ob %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = treatment, values_from = mu) %>%
  mutate(effect = Hp / Ctrl) %>%
  select(.draw, sex, effect)

baseline_stats_ob <- baseline_ratio_ob %>%
  group_by(sex) %>%
  summarise(
    Ratio = median(effect),
    CI_Lower = quantile(effect, 0.025),
    CI_Upper = quantile(effect, 0.975),
    Prob_Decrease = mean(effect < 1),
    Pd = pmax(mean(effect < 1), mean(effect > 1)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 3)))

print(baseline_stats_ob)

pre_plot_df_ob <- baseline_ratio_ob %>%
  group_by(sex) %>%
  summarise(
    median  = median(effect),
    CI_low  = quantile(effect, 0.025),
    CI_high = quantile(effect, 0.975),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    phase = "Pre (Chow)",
    biomarker = "Observed species",
    label = "Treatment (Hp/Ctrl), baseline (avg. across chow weeks)",
    type = "Simple Effects"
  )

# ============================================================
# POST (Post only): NB model + effects on ratio scale
# ============================================================

model_post_ob_nb <- brm(
  Observed ~ sex * diet * treatment + (1 | mouseID),
  data = data_post,
  family = negbinomial(link = "log"),
  prior = c(
    prior(normal(0, 1), class = "b"),
    prior(exponential(1), class = "shape"),
    prior(exponential(1), class = "sd")
  ),
  chains = 4, iter = 4000, warmup = 2000,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99),
  backend = "cmdstanr",
  seed = 123
)

grid_post_ob <- tidyr::expand_grid(
  sex = levels(data_post$sex),
  diet = levels(data_post$diet),
  treatment = levels(data_post$treatment)
)

draws_post_ob <- model_post_ob_nb %>%
  add_epred_draws(newdata = grid_post_ob, ndraws = 2000, re_formula = NA)

preds_post_ob <- draws_post_ob %>%
  group_by(.draw, sex, diet, treatment) %>%
  summarise(epred = mean(.epred), .groups = "drop")

# -------------------------
# SIMPLE EFFECTS (Post)
# -------------------------
# Treatment within diet: Hp/Ctrl in CD & HFD
eff_simple_treat_ob <- preds_post_ob %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = treatment, values_from = epred) %>%
  mutate(effect = Hp / Ctrl) %>%
  group_by(sex, diet) %>%
  summarise(
    median = median(effect),
    CI_low = quantile(effect, 0.025),
    CI_high = quantile(effect, 0.975),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    phase = "Post (Diet switch)",
    biomarker = "Observed species",
    type = "Simple Effects",
    label = paste0("Treatment (Hp/Ctrl) in ", diet)
  )

# Diet within treatment: HFD/CD in Ctrl & Hp
eff_simple_diet_ob <- preds_post_ob %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = diet, values_from = epred) %>%
  mutate(effect = HFD / CD) %>%
  group_by(sex, treatment) %>%
  summarise(
    median = median(effect),
    CI_low = quantile(effect, 0.025),
    CI_high = quantile(effect, 0.975),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    phase = "Post (Diet switch)",
    biomarker = "Observed species",
    type = "Simple Effects",
    label = paste0("Diet (HFD/CD) in ", treatment)
  )

# -------------------------
# MAIN EFFECTS (Post)
# -------------------------
# Main Treatment effect: average Hp/Ctrl over diets within draw
eff_main_treat_ob <- preds_post_ob %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = treatment, values_from = epred) %>%
  mutate(Hp_over_Ctrl = Hp / Ctrl) %>%
  group_by(.draw, sex) %>%
  summarise(effect = mean(Hp_over_Ctrl), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(sex) %>%
  summarise(
    median = median(effect),
    CI_low = quantile(effect, 0.025),
    CI_high = quantile(effect, 0.975),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    phase = "Post (Diet switch)",
    biomarker = "Observed species",
    type = "Main Effects",
    label = "Treatment (Hp/Ctrl)"
  )

# Main Diet effect: average HFD/CD over treatments within draw
eff_main_diet_ob <- preds_post_ob %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = diet, values_from = epred) %>%
  mutate(HFD_over_CD = HFD / CD) %>%
  group_by(.draw, sex) %>%
  summarise(effect = mean(HFD_over_CD), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(sex) %>%
  summarise(
    median = median(effect),
    CI_low = quantile(effect, 0.025),
    CI_high = quantile(effect, 0.975),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    phase = "Post (Diet switch)",
    biomarker = "Observed species",
    type = "Main Effects",
    label = "Diet (HFD/CD)"
  )

# Interaction: (Hp/Ctrl in HFD) / (Hp/Ctrl in CD)
eff_interaction_ob <- preds_post_ob %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = treatment, values_from = epred) %>%
  mutate(Hp_over_Ctrl = Hp / Ctrl) %>%
  select(.draw, sex, diet, Hp_over_Ctrl) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = diet, values_from = Hp_over_Ctrl) %>%
  mutate(effect = HFD / CD) %>%   # ratio-of-ratios
  group_by(sex) %>%
  summarise(
    median = median(effect),
    CI_low = quantile(effect, 0.025),
    CI_high = quantile(effect, 0.975),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    phase = "Post (Diet switch)",
    biomarker = "Observed species",
    type = "Interaction",
    label = "Interaction: (Hp/Ctrl) HFD ÷ CD"
  )

# ============================================================
# COMBINE + ORDER
# ============================================================

pre_plot_df_ob <- pre_plot_df_ob %>%
  mutate(label = "Treatment (Hp/Ctrl), baseline (avg. across chow weeks)",
         type = "Simple Effects")

eff_main_treat_ob <- eff_main_treat_ob %>%
  mutate(label = "Treatment (Hp/Ctrl)", type = "Main Effects")

eff_main_diet_ob <- eff_main_diet_ob %>%
  mutate(label = "Diet (HFD/CD)", type = "Main Effects")

eff_interaction_ob <- eff_interaction_ob %>%
  mutate(label = "Interaction: (Hp/Ctrl) HFD ÷ CD", type = "Interaction")

eff_simple_treat_ob <- eff_simple_treat_ob %>%
  mutate(label = paste0("Treatment (Hp/Ctrl) in ", diet),
         type = "Simple Effects")

eff_simple_diet_ob <- eff_simple_diet_ob %>%
  mutate(label = paste0("Diet (HFD/CD) in ", treatment),
         type = "Simple Effects")


# 1) Recode long labels -> short standard labels
recode_labels <- function(x) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    # baseline row (Observed)
    str_detect(x, "baseline") ~ "Treatment (pre diet switch)",

    # main effects
    x %in% c("Diet (HFD/CD)") ~ "Diet",
    x %in% c("Treatment (Hp/Ctrl)") ~ "Treatment",

    # interaction
    str_detect(x, "^Interaction") ~ "Interaction",

    # simple effects
    str_detect(x, "^Diet \\(HFD/CD\\) in Ctrl") ~ "Diet in Ctrl",
    str_detect(x, "^Diet \\(HFD/CD\\) in Hp")   ~ "Diet in Hp",
    str_detect(x, "^Treatment \\(Hp/Ctrl\\) in CD")  ~ "Treatment in CD",
    str_detect(x, "^Treatment \\(Hp/Ctrl\\) in HFD") ~ "Treatment in HFD",

    TRUE ~ x
  )
}

# 2) Shared row order
label_levels_std <- c(
  "Diet in Ctrl",
  "Diet in Hp",
  "Treatment in CD",
  "Treatment in HFD",
  "Interaction",
  "Diet",
  "Treatment",
  "Treatment (pre diet switch)"
)

# 3) Bind THEN recode/factorize labels
plot_df_div_ob <- bind_rows(
  pre_plot_df_ob,
  eff_main_diet_ob,
  eff_main_treat_ob,
  eff_interaction_ob,
  eff_simple_diet_ob,
  eff_simple_treat_ob
) %>%
  mutate(
    label = recode_labels(as.character(label)),
    label = factor(label, levels = label_levels_std),
    type  = factor(type, levels = c("Main Effects", "Interaction", "Simple Effects")),
    sex   = factor(sex,  levels = c("female", "male"))
  )

# 4) Forest plot (ratio scale)
ST_Observed_fecal_pre_post_forest <- ggplot(plot_df_div_ob,
                                            aes(y = label, x = median, color = sex)) +
  geom_pointrange(
    aes(xmin = CI_low, xmax = CI_high, shape = type),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.6),
    size = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("female" = "#b19cd9", "male" = "#6a0dad")) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(
    "Main Effects"   = 16,
    "Interaction"    = 18,
    "Simple Effects" = 15
  )) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y        = element_text(color = "black"),
    legend.position    = "bottom",
    legend.box         = "vertical"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Effect ratio (Hp / Control)",
    y = "",
    color = "Sex",
    shape = "Effect type"
  )

ST_Observed_fecal_pre_post_forest
```

```{r}

###diversity at experiment termination

# Filter and prepare the data
alpha_div_GIT_ST <- alpha_div_ST %>%
  filter(!is.na(treatment), timepoint == "t4") %>%
  mutate(
    sample_type = case_when(
      sample_type == "stomach" ~ "Stomach",
      sample_type == "ileum" ~ "Ileum",
      sample_type == "fecal" ~ "Colon"
    ),
    sample_type = factor(sample_type, levels = c("Stomach", "Ileum", "Colon"))
  )

# --- 1. Fit Model  ---


fit_Shannon_t4 <- brm(
  Shannon ~ treatment * sex * diet + (1 + treatment * sex * diet | sample_type),
  data = alpha_div_GIT_ST,
  family = student(),
  prior = c(
    prior(normal(0, 1), class = "b"),
    prior(exponential(1), class = "sd"),
    prior(student_t(3, 0, 1), class = "sigma")
  ), 
  chains = 4, iter = 4000, warmup = 2000,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99, max_treedepth = 15),
  backend = "cmdstanr",
  seed = 123
)

# --- 2. Prediction Grid ---
newdata_t4 <- tidyr::expand_grid(
  sample_type = unique(fit_Shannon_t4$data$sample_type),
  sex         = unique(fit_Shannon_t4$data$sex),
  treatment   = unique(fit_Shannon_t4$data$treatment),
  diet        = unique(fit_Shannon_t4$data$diet)
)

message("Generating predictions...")
preds_t4 <- tidybayes::add_epred_draws(
  newdata_t4,
  fit_Shannon_t4,
  re_formula = ~ (1 + treatment * sex * diet | sample_type)
)

# --- CALCULATE EFFECTS WITH 95% AND 80% INTERVALS ---

# A. Global Main Effect: Treatment
eff_main_treat_t4 <- preds_t4 %>%
  dplyr::group_by(sample_type, sex, treatment, .draw) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(epred = mean(.epred), .groups = "drop") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = treatment, values_from = epred) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(effect = Hp - Ctrl) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(sample_type, sex) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    median    = median(effect),
    CI_low    = quantile(effect, 0.025),
    CI_high   = quantile(effect, 0.975),
    CI80_low  = quantile(effect, 0.10),
    CI80_high = quantile(effect, 0.90),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(type = "Main Effects", label = "Treatment")

# B. Global Main Effect: Diet
eff_main_diet_t4 <- preds_t4 %>%
  dplyr::group_by(sample_type, sex, diet, .draw) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(epred = mean(.epred), .groups = "drop") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = diet, values_from = epred) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(effect = HFD - CD) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(sample_type, sex) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    median    = median(effect),
    CI_low    = quantile(effect, 0.025),
    CI_high   = quantile(effect, 0.975),
    CI80_low  = quantile(effect, 0.10),
    CI80_high = quantile(effect, 0.90),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(type = "Main Effects", label = "Diet")

# C. Interaction
eff_interaction_t4 <- preds_t4 %>%
  dplyr::group_by(sample_type, sex, diet, treatment, .draw) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(epred = mean(.epred), .groups = "drop") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = c(treatment, diet), values_from = epred) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    diff_HFD = Hp_HFD - Ctrl_HFD,
    diff_CD  = Hp_CD - Ctrl_CD,
    effect   = diff_HFD - diff_CD
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(sample_type, sex) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    median    = median(effect),
    CI_low    = quantile(effect, 0.025),
    CI_high   = quantile(effect, 0.975),
    CI80_low  = quantile(effect, 0.10),
    CI80_high = quantile(effect, 0.90),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(type = "Interaction", label = "Interaction")

# D. Simple Effects: Treatment WITHIN Diet
eff_simple_treat_t4 <- preds_t4 %>%
  dplyr::group_by(sample_type, sex, diet, treatment, .draw) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(epred = mean(.epred), .groups = "drop") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = treatment, values_from = epred) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(effect = Hp - Ctrl) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(sample_type, sex, diet) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    median    = median(effect),
    CI_low    = quantile(effect, 0.025),
    CI_high   = quantile(effect, 0.975),
    CI80_low  = quantile(effect, 0.10),
    CI80_high = quantile(effect, 0.90),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(type = "Simple Effects", label = paste("Treatment in", diet))

# E. Simple Effects: Diet WITHIN Treatment
eff_simple_diet_t4 <- preds_t4 %>%
  dplyr::group_by(sample_type, sex, diet, treatment, .draw) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(epred = mean(.epred), .groups = "drop") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = diet, values_from = epred) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(effect = HFD - CD) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(sample_type, sex, treatment) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    median    = median(effect),
    CI_low    = quantile(effect, 0.025),
    CI_high   = quantile(effect, 0.975),
    CI80_low  = quantile(effect, 0.10),
    CI80_high = quantile(effect, 0.90),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(type = "Simple Effects", label = paste("Diet in", treatment))

# --- COMBINE AND ORDER ---
plot_data_t4 <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  eff_main_treat_t4,
  eff_main_diet_t4,
  eff_interaction_t4,
  eff_simple_treat_t4,
  eff_simple_diet_t4
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    is_sig = (CI_low > 0 | CI_high < 0),
    label = factor(label, levels = c(
      "Diet in Hp", "Diet in Ctrl",
      "Treatment in HFD", "Treatment in CD",
      "Interaction",
      "Diet", "Treatment"
    )),
    type = factor(type, levels = c("Main Effects", "Interaction", "Simple Effects"))
  )

# --- CREATE PLOT ---
dodge_t4 <- position_dodge(width = 0.6)

p_final_t4 <- ggplot2::ggplot(
  plot_data_t4,
  ggplot2::aes(x = label, y = median, color = sex)
) +
  # 95% CI = thinner outer line
  ggplot2::geom_linerange(
    ggplot2::aes(ymin = CI_low, ymax = CI_high),
    position = dodge_t4,
    linewidth = 0.8,
    alpha = 0.65
  ) +
  # 80% CI = thicker inner line
  ggplot2::geom_linerange(
    ggplot2::aes(ymin = CI80_low, ymax = CI80_high),
    position = dodge_t4,
    linewidth = 2.2
  ) +
  # median point
  ggplot2::geom_point(
    ggplot2::aes(shape = type),
    position = dodge_t4,
    size = 2.7
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  ggplot2::coord_flip() +
  ggplot2::facet_wrap(~ sample_type, nrow = 1) +
  ggplot2::scale_color_manual(values = c("female" = "#b19cd9", "male" = "#6a0dad")) +
  ggplot2::scale_shape_manual(values = c(
    "Main Effects"   = 16,
    "Interaction"    = 18,
    "Simple Effects" = 15
  )) +
  ggplot2::theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  ggplot2::theme(
    plot.title         = ggplot2::element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    panel.grid.major.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    axis.text.y        = ggplot2::element_text(color = "black"),
    strip.text         = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold")
  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    x = "",
    y = "Effect difference in Shannon diversity",
    color = "Sex",
    shape = "Effect Type"
  )

p_final_t4
# Save
ggsave("ST_Shannon_GIT.jpeg", plot = p_final_t4, width = 10, height = 5, units = "in")
```

```{r}
#correlation between shannon index and Hp load in stomach
df_alpha_hp <- alpha_div_GIT_ST %>%
  filter(sampletype == "stomach") %>%
  filter(treatment=="Hp")%>%
  left_join(MS1_Hp_loads_ST, by = "mouseID") %>%

  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Shannon), !is.na(log10_Hp_copies_std))


fit_shannon_hp_stomach <- brm(
  Shannon ~ log10_Hp_copies_std,
  data = df_alpha_hp,
  family = gaussian(),
  prior = c(
    prior(normal(0, 1), class = "b"),       # slope
    prior(student_t(3, 0, 1), class = "sigma")
  ),
  chains = 4, iter = 4000, warmup = 2000,
  seed = 123
)

summary(fit_shannon_hp_stomach)
posterior <- as_draws_df(fit_shannon_hp_stomach)

mean(posterior$b_log10_Hp_copies_std < 0)  # P(negative)

  )
```

```{r}
fit_observed_t4 <- brm(
  Observed ~ treatment * sex * diet + (1 + treatment * sex * diet | sample_type),
  data = alpha_div_GIT_ST,
  family = negbinomial(link = "log"),
  prior = c(
    prior(normal(0, 1), class = "b"),           # effects on log-mean => exp(b) are ratios
    #prior(normal(log(mean(alpha_div_GIT_ST$Observed)), 1), class = "Intercept"),
    prior(exponential(1), class = "sd"),        # RE SDs
    prior(exponential(1), class = "shape")      # overdispersion
  ),
  chains = 4, iter = 4000, warmup = 2000,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99, max_treedepth = 15),
  backend = "cmdstanr",
  seed = 123
)
    


# --- 2. Prediction Grid ---
newdata_t4_ob <- tidyr::expand_grid(
  sample_type = unique(fit_observed_t4$data$sample_type),

)

message("Generating predictions...")
preds_t4_ob <- tidybayes::add_epred_draws(
  newdata_t4_ob,
  fit_observed_t4,
  re_formula = ~ (1 + treatment * sex * diet | sample_type)
)

# --- CALCULATE EFFECTS WITH 95% AND 80% INTERVALS ---

# A. Global Main Effect: Treatment (Hp/Ctrl), averaged across diet
eff_main_treat_t4_ob <- preds_t4_ob %>%
  dplyr::group_by(sample_type, sex, treatment, .draw) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(epred = mean(.epred), .groups = "drop") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = treatment, values_from = epred) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(effect = Hp / Ctrl) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(sample_type, sex) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    median    = median(effect),
    CI_low    = quantile(effect, 0.025),
    CI_high   = quantile(effect, 0.975),
    CI80_low  = quantile(effect, 0.10),
    CI80_high = quantile(effect, 0.90),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(type = "Main Effects", label = "Treatment")

# B. Global Main Effect: Diet (HFD/CD), averaged across treatment
eff_main_diet_t4_ob <- preds_t4_ob %>%
  dplyr::group_by(sample_type, sex, diet, .draw) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(epred = mean(.epred), .groups = "drop") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = diet, values_from = epred) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(effect = HFD / CD) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(sample_type, sex) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    median    = median(effect),
    CI_low    = quantile(effect, 0.025),
    CI_high   = quantile(effect, 0.975),
    CI80_low  = quantile(effect, 0.10),
    CI80_high = quantile(effect, 0.90),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(type = "Main Effects", label = "Diet")

# C. Interaction: (Hp/Ctrl in HFD) / (Hp/Ctrl in CD)  (ratio-of-ratios)
eff_interaction_t4_ob <- preds_t4_ob %>%
  dplyr::group_by(sample_type, sex, diet, treatment, .draw) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(epred = mean(.epred), .groups = "drop") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = c(treatment, diet), values_from = epred) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    ratio_HFD = Hp_HFD / Ctrl_HFD,
    ratio_CD  = Hp_CD / Ctrl_CD,
    effect    = ratio_HFD / ratio_CD
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(sample_type, sex) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    median    = median(effect),
    CI_low    = quantile(effect, 0.025),
    CI_high   = quantile(effect, 0.975),
    CI80_low  = quantile(effect, 0.10),
    CI80_high = quantile(effect, 0.90),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(type = "Interaction", label = "Interaction")

# D. Simple Effects: Treatment within Diet (Hp/Ctrl)
eff_simple_treat_t4_ob <- preds_t4_ob %>%
  dplyr::group_by(sample_type, sex, diet, treatment, .draw) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(epred = mean(.epred), .groups = "drop") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = treatment, values_from = epred) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(effect = Hp / Ctrl) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(sample_type, sex, diet) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    median    = median(effect),
    CI_low    = quantile(effect, 0.025),
    CI_high   = quantile(effect, 0.975),
    CI80_low  = quantile(effect, 0.10),
    CI80_high = quantile(effect, 0.90),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(type = "Simple Effects", label = paste("Treatment in", diet))

# E. Simple Effects: Diet within Treatment (HFD/CD)
eff_simple_diet_t4_ob <- preds_t4_ob %>%
  dplyr::group_by(sample_type, sex, diet, treatment, .draw) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(epred = mean(.epred), .groups = "drop") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = diet, values_from = epred) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(effect = HFD / CD) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(sample_type, sex, treatment) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    median    = median(effect),
    CI_low    = quantile(effect, 0.025),
    CI_high   = quantile(effect, 0.975),
    CI80_low  = quantile(effect, 0.10),
    CI80_high = quantile(effect, 0.90),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(type = "Simple Effects", label = paste("Diet in", treatment))

# --- COMBINE AND ORDER ---
plot_data_t4_ob <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  eff_main_treat_t4_ob,
  eff_main_diet_t4_ob,
  eff_interaction_t4_ob,
  eff_simple_treat_t4_ob,
  eff_simple_diet_t4_ob
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    is_sig = (CI_low > 1 | CI_high < 1),
    label = factor(label, levels = c(
      "Diet in Hp", "Diet in Ctrl",
      "Treatment in HFD", "Treatment in CD",
      "Interaction",
      "Diet", "Treatment"
    )),
    type = factor(type, levels = c("Main Effects", "Interaction", "Simple Effects"))
  )

# --- CREATE PLOT ---
dodge_t4_ob <- position_dodge(width = 0.6)

p_final_t4_ob <- ggplot2::ggplot(
  plot_data_t4_ob,

) +
  # 95% CI = thinner outer line

  ) +

  )) +
```
